interactive_booking_system.flow_description: Interactive multi-step intuitive booking widget. Client selects service (Corte R$25, Barba R$15, Combo R$35), chooses preferred barber (Dhow - Mestre da Casa or Lucas Navalha), picks date (today, tomorrow, or calendar date), chooses available time slot (09:00 to 20:00 with 30m steps), types their name & observation, and clicks 'Confirmar no WhatsApp'.
interactive_booking_system.instant_feedback: Shows real-time calculated total, summary card, and triggers Sonner toast on WhatsApp dispatch. Also saves booking history in local storage for quick re-booking.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. The template is farm-ts (FastAPI backend + Vite/React 19 frontend). Use frontend/src/index.css for Tailwind v4 tokens and theme variables.

2. In frontend/src/index.css, import '@fontsource-variable/playfair-display' and '@fontsource-variable/instrument-sans' and '@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono'. Set --font-heading: 'Playfair Display Variable', serif; and --font-sans: 'Instrument Sans Variable', sans-serif;.
3. Set <html class='dark'> in frontend/index.html to ensure dark mode by default with luxurious deep charcoal and gold accents.
4. Prices MUST be explicitly featured: Corte R$25, Barba R$15, Combo R$35. Do not alter these prices.
5. WhatsApp booking MUST target phone number 5562982564548 with a clean formatted message encoding (encodeURIComponent).
6. Include both the full-featured Interactive Booking Section and the Floating WhatsApp Quick Trigger.
7. Implement sound interactive feedback: Sonner toast on booking click ('Abrindo WhatsApp para confirmar seu agendamento...'), copy toast for phone number, and service selector calculator.
8. Add data-testid to every interactive element (data-testid='btn-book-hero', data-testid='input-client-name', data-testid='select-service', data-testid='btn-whatsapp-floating', etc.).
9. Use Lucide icons (Scissors, Sparkles, Clock, Calendar, MapPin, Phone, MessageCircle, Star, Check, ArrowRight, ShieldCheck, User).
10. Ensure the website has rich Portuguese (pt-BR) copy tailored for a premium Brazilian barbershop customer experience.
